title.en: An Act Authorizing Provincial Boards of Provinces Having Subprovinces to Appropriate Funds for Quarters for the Lieutenant-Governors of their Respective Subprovinces.

text.en:
Provincial boards of provinces having subprovinces are hereby authorized to appropriate out of
their general funds a sum not to exceed thirty pesos a month for quarters for the lieutenant-governors of their
respective subprovinces.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 28, 1930.
